info.title: trax-console
info.description: trax-console, the Trax .NET operations console in a terminal: runs, dead letters, the work queue, manifests, a run's trace and machine instances, read and acted on over a host's Trax GraphQL operations surface with the same documents the browser console sends. Also answers in JSON lines for scripts and agents. Install it with `dotnet tool install -g Trax.Api.Console.Terminal`.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: The Trax .NET operations console in a terminal. With no command it opens the console; with one it answers in JSON lines.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --host
options.description: The host serving the operations console, such as https://ops.example.com (or TRAX_CONSOLE_HOST).

options.name: --graphql-path
options.description: The path its Trax GraphQL endpoint is mapped at. [default: /trax/graphql]

options.name: --api-key-file
options.description: A file holding the API key the operations gate checks. Or set TRAX_CONSOLE_API_KEY. Never on the command line itself.

options.name: --token-file
options.description: A file holding a bearer token. Or set TRAX_CONSOLE_TOKEN.

options.name: --send-text
options.description: Send each document's text instead of its id, for a host that runs no persisted operations. [default: False]

options.name: --any-version
options.description: Talk to a host of another Trax release anyway. Documents that differ between the two are refused. A host that refuses the credential or cannot be reached is still refused. [default: False]

options.name: --vertical-graphs
options.description: Draw machines top to bottom rather than left to right (r turns them in the console). [default: False]

commands.name: list
commands.description: Print a page of a list, one row per line.

options.name: --where
options.description: A filter as name=value (state=FAILED). Repeatable. An unknown name is refused with the list's filters.

options.name: --take
options.description: How many rows to read (at most 500). [default: 25]

options.name: --after
options.description: The cursor to start after: the nextCursor the previous page printed.

arguments.name: LIST
arguments.description: One of runs, dead-letters, work-queue, manifests.

commands.name: do
commands.description: Run an action on rows of a list, by id.

options.name: --note
options.description: The note an action records (acknowledge).

options.name: --ask-afresh
options.description: Let a requeued or triggered run ask its decisions again rather than replay them. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would be sent, and send nothing. [default: False]

arguments.name: LIST
arguments.description: One of runs, dead-letters, work-queue, manifests.

commands.name: bulk
commands.description: Run an action on every row a filter matches, as one bulk operation the host runs.

options.name: --where
options.description: A filter as name=value (state=FAILED). Repeatable. An unknown name is refused with the list's filters.

options.name: --expect
options.description: How many rows the filter matches, as `list` counted them. The host refuses when it now matches another.

options.name: --note
options.description: The note an action records (acknowledge).

options.name: --ask-afresh
options.description: Let a requeued or triggered run ask its decisions again rather than replay them. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would be sent, and send nothing. [default: False]

arguments.name: LIST
arguments.description: One of runs, dead-letters, work-queue, manifests.

commands.name: watch
commands.description: Follow a stream, one event per line, until interrupted.

arguments.name: STREAM
arguments.description: runs (every run's state), changes (what changed), run (one run's steps), machines.

arguments.name: ID
arguments.description: The run's id, for `run`; a machine's name, for `machines`.

commands.name: trace
commands.description: Print a run's steps, decisions and log, one per line.

commands.name: graph
commands.description: Draw a machine's states and transitions as boxes and arrows.

arguments.name: MACHINE
arguments.description: The machine; every machine the host serves when left out.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Say whether the host serves this console: its Trax release, and whether the credential reaches operations.
